title: Dreams
headline: Mick Fleetwood waited a day to add congas to 'Dreams'
caption:
Ken Caillat, one of the producers on Fleetwood Mac's 'Dreams', has a dry way of talking about its drums. When people point to this song as proof of the classic Mick Fleetwood and John McVie rhythm section, he says, "I'm always amused that they're talking about a drum loop."

It's a funny line, because the loop is only where the drums start. It was cut from Fleetwood's own playing, and he kept adding to it, with tom-toms in the pre-chorus and then congas the next day, because they weren't readily available in that session. And Stevie Nicks's guide vocal stayed on the record because no later take could recapture its interplay with those drums.

🎧 The song: "Dreams" by Fleetwood Mac
